Hi Evelyn & team,

Quick intro — Priya Singh is a strong mid-senior SWE candidate (backend + infra) we think matches Redwood's infra role. She has availability next week and requested a condensed virtual fullloop (one continuous block) due to travel. Can you confirm if you can accommodate a 3-hour window on 7/6 or 7/7 (PT) and whether you prefer the classic tech -> system -> behavioral order or a product-first flow?

Candidate details (short):
- Priya Singh — priya.singh@gmail.com / +1 (415) 555-0192
- Focus: distributed systems, reliability, leader-level IC
- Two work samples: design doc + small code repo (links sent separately)

High level ask:
1) Confirm whether a 3-hour contiguous slot is OK.
2) Propose panel sequence and any pairing (two interviewers together vs single).
3) Confirm who will scribe for debrief.

Thanks — we can drop a draft invite (ICS) once you confirm.

Best,
Alex Ramirez
BrightPath Talent

Subject: Re: Candidate intro — Priya Singh (SWE Full-loop) / availability

Thanks Alex — happy to run this. A condensed 3-hour fullloop works for us on either date; we prefer 3pm–6pm PT (compact window) if candidate is okay. Proposed sequence below (keeps heavy system/context early):

Proposed panel sequencing (3hr compact):
- 15m intro / recruiter context + candidate questions (Evelyn)
- 60m System design (Karthik) — primary interviewer + 1 reviewer
- 10m short break
- 45m Product/feature deep-dive (Laura) — cross-functional lens
- 40m Team fit / behavioral + launch conversations (Marissa)
- 10m buffer & close / next steps (Evelyn)

Pairing & scribe:
- Karthik will be primary for system design; Marissa can join as co-evaluator for the last 40m.
- Laura will run the product deep-dive.
- Marissa — can you be the scribe for the debrief doc (quick notes) so we have a single canonical evaluation? If you'd rather not, I can assign a junior PM scribe.

Logistics: 1) We should include a short whiteboard-friendly prompt for system design (candidate can share a deck). 2) If candidate prefers, we can move the 10m break to after product instead.

I'll hold the slot tentatively and attach a draft ICS and a one-pager cue-card for interviewers; please confirm ASAP so I can send candidate the official invite.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Talent Ops, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (650) 555-0124

Evelyn — happy to scribe the debrief and take team-fit. One small tweak: can we move the 10m break to occur immediately after the system design (so it's earlier)? It gives the interviewers a chance to breathe and gives Priya time to switch context. Also, if possible I prefer the product deep-dive to be ~50m and team-fit 30m — but happy to stick to your timeline if that helps calendar packing.

I'll block my calendar tentatively for 3pm–6pm PT on 7/6 and 7/7 until we lock a date.

Thanks — happy to own System Design. A couple of operational notes:
- I prefer system design first (60m) while candidate is freshest, then a 15m break (rather than 10). We can compress the product discussion to 40m and keep team fit at 35m.
- For pairing: I'll bring a second engineer to listen for scalability/ops edge cases — they will not lead but will vote in the debrief. If that's OK, I'll invite Karan (from infra team) as the second listener.
- Scribe: Marissa scribing is ideal. If Marissa needs a backup, Laura — could you cover notes for the product portion?

I'll prepare a short prompt and share by EOD: a high-level design problem with explicit NFRs (scale to 10k rps, consistent hashing cache layer, failure modes).

Karthik
